subject: Next steps: procurement path & billing trigger for ClearScope trial
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@clearscope.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: procurement path & billing trigger for ClearScope trial

Hi Emily — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick post-call recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on procurement and how/when billing would start when you move from trial to paid.

Recap (high level):
- Goal: prove LLM inference for search reranking and summarization within two-week pilot across 3 internal datasets.
- Success criteria: 1) 15–20% improvement in click-through on re-ranked results vs baseline OR 2) summary relevance score >= 4.0 on your internal rubric for 8/10 test prompts.
- Trial scope: up to 50k inference tokens/day for pilot users (we can increase if needed).

Questions / next steps I think we need to confirm:
1) Procurement path: PO vs corporate card vs marketplace. If PO, what is the internal PO owner and timeline?
2) SOC2 / evidence needs: you mentioned SOC2 is required for procurement — who should we loop in from security?
3) Billing trigger: do you want billing to start on a calendar date (e.g., first of month) or when usage passes a threshold? You suggested 20k tokens as a potential trigger on the call — confirm please.

Attachments: I’ve attached the updated pricing sheet for the pilot (Redwood-pricing-sheet-v3.pdf). I also attached a short template for procurement instructions (Procurement_instructions_ClearScope.pdf) that outlines PO flow and invoicing options — happy to adapt to your legal.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Emily/CS: confirm procurement owner and whether PO is required (Carlos? cc’d)
- Emily: confirm target billing trigger (threshold vs date) and any required success metrics edits
- Rohan: set up a 30-min procurement sync with our finance/legal to walk the PO path if needed (can do early next week)

If that matches your understanding, I’ll book a short call with Carlos + Marissa + our legal ops to close the PO instructions.

Thanks — Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148
https://redwood.ai/resources

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@clearscope.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@clearscope.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement path & billing trigger for ClearScope trial

Rohan — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below (and attaching our procurement timeline for visibility).

1) Procurement path: We prefer PO / invoice for anything > $10k. Carlos (cc’d) is our procurement lead and will own PO issuance. Our legal will want a short SOC2 attestation and an AUP note.
2) Billing trigger: We’d like billing to start when cumulative usage for the pilot reaches 20,000 tokens OR after 14 calendar days from pilot start, whichever comes first. That gives us a safety net.
3) Marketplace: We’re interested in marketplace (GCP Marketplace) for long-term procurement simplicity, but for this pilot we’ll do PO direct to Redwood to keep timelines tight.

Attachments: "CS_procurement_timeline_Feb2027.pdf" (internal timeline)

Would appreciate if your team can share the SOC2 cert or a one-pager on controls. Also, can you confirm invoicing cadence and whether Redwood can accept a Net 30 PO?

Thanks — Emily
Emily Zhang
Director, Data Products | ClearScope Analytics
emily.zhang@clearscope.ai | (415) 555-2121

Great — thanks for the confirmations. Next steps and actions on our side: 

1) I’ve attached the finalized procurement instructions and the pilot success metrics template (Procurement_instructions_ClearScope.pdf, trial-success-metrics.xlsx). These include the PO fields we need, sample invoice layout, and recommended billing cadence (monthly, Net 30).
2) Marissa will host a 20-min procurement walkthrough with Carlos and his legal on Wed 10 Feb at 10:00 PT — calendar invite to follow.
3) Redwood will provide SOC2 attestation and security one-pager via the shared Drive link Marissa dropped.
4) Billing trigger confirmed: start of billing = first occurrence of (a) cumulative pilot usage >= 20,000 tokens OR (b) 14 calendar days after pilot activation, whichever happens first. We will not auto-charge without PO/invoice in place; if ClearScope provides a PO, we'll invoice per Net 30.

Carlos — please confirm your PO number format and any internal reference we should include on the invoice. If you prefer we send via marketplace later, we can discuss that after pilot success.

Thanks all — I’ll send the invite and track items in the HubSpot deal (RDW-2378).
